delhi_token.opens_days_before_basis: the 12 December 2026 sitting, whose download window opens 7 December 2026 — 5 days ahead (the 25 October 2026 sitting's window opened 6 days ahead, on 19 October; the 10 October edition it superseded would have opened 5 days ahead, on 5 October; and the 9 May 2026 sitting's window opened 5 days ahead too, on 4 May) — so 5-6 days ahead is DSLSA's observed pattern, not a fixed rule.
delhi_token.daily_cap_note: For the 12 December 2026 sitting, DSLSA's notification (Ref. No. 12/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/13439, dated 3 November 2026, fetched and read directly as a scanned PDF via dslsa.org's own notice page) says that compoundable challans pending on the Virtual Court portal till 31.08.2026 will be taken up, and that litigants/violators can download the challan slip(s) directly through the Delhi Traffic Police link "from 07.12.2026 at 10 a.m. onwards, subject to a maximum limit of 50,000 challans per day, till exhausting the overall limit of 2 lakh challans" — the daily and overall caps are unchanged from every prior 2026 sitting, but the eligibility cutoff (31.08.2026) and window-opening date (07.12.2026) are new for this cycle.
delhi_token.limits_note: The notification sets no closing date for the download window and no per-vehicle limit — the window runs until the overall 2 lakh cap is exhausted, not until a fixed date. This is the 4th National Lok Adalat of 2026, to be held 12.12.2026 (Second Saturday) in all Delhi District Courts complexes (Tis Hazari, Karkardooma, Patiala House, Rohini, Saket, Dwarka, Rouse Avenue), the High Court of Delhi, DRTs, Permanent Lok Adalats and the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions. Unlike the September-to-October-to-October reshuffle this year, no postponement has been reported or published for this date as of this check. Re-checked 23 November 2026 (within the 21-day window of the 12 December sitting, as the playbook requires): dslsa.org's public-notices listing (page 1 of 27, newest first) shows the 03.11.2026-dated notification (Ref. No. 13439) as the only Lok-Adalat-dated item on file; nothing newer bears on the date or token window. No update needed yet to national_sittings beyond this; will re-check again as 7 December (window opening) approaches in case of a postponement, which has been Delhi's pattern in three of the last four 2026 cycles. Re-checked 25 November 2026 (still within the 21-day window): dslsa.org's notification page for the 12.12.2026 sitting (Ref. No. 13439, dated 3 November 2026) still shows no postponement or amendment — same token window, same caps, same eligibility cutoff.

delhi_extras.weekend_courts_note: Outside National Lok Adalat dates, Delhi's district court complexes have run weekend traffic courts since July 2026, alongside evening traffic courts on working days. Challan slips are downloaded from the Delhi Traffic Police portal, choosing a court complex and a slot; the rosters are published as circulars by the district courts.

state_notes.note: Karnataka is not sitting on 12 September 2026. The Karnataka State Legal Services Authority postponed the third National Lok Adalat to Saturday 19 September 2026, 2.00 p.m. to 5.30 p.m., by letter No. KSLSA:08/NLA/2026 dated 18 August 2026, addressed to every District Legal Services Authority in the state. If your challan is in Karnataka, 19 September is the date that applies to you.

Delhi's National Lok Adalat has moved twice. It was first postponed from 12 September 2026 to Saturday 10 October 2026, by Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/10673 dated 25 August 2026, because the Delhi High Court had declared 12 September a court sitting day for courts subordinate to it (Notification No.85/G-4/Genl.-I/DHC dated 21 August 2026). It was then postponed again, from 10 October 2026 to Sunday 25 October 2026, by Ref. No. 10/DSLSA/ADRW/NLAs/2026/11105 dated 9 September 2026, because the Delhi High Court declared 10 October itself a court sitting day for subordinate courts (Notification No.86/G-4/Genl.-I/DHC dated 8 September 2026). If your challan is in Delhi, 25 October 2026 is the date that applies to you, and the traffic-challan token download window now opens 19 October 2026 at 10 a.m., not 5 October.
